fields.title: 📖 Justice even against oneself
fields.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Stand firmly for justice as witnesses for Allah, even if it is against yourselves, your parents or close relatives.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The judge and the witness do not serve family, benefit or party. They stand for Allah’s right.

immutable.source: 📝 aṭ-Ṭabarī und Ibn Kathīr, Tafsīr zu Sūrah an-Nisāʾ 4:135.
